candidate_requirements.requirement: Request current severity, inflammatory and liver/organ-function evidence.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Jaundice, abdominal pain and high fever raise a potentially urgent biliary infection or obstruction problem before any unusual pathology is known.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Liver tests plus inflammatory markers and a current sepsis/organ-function assessment, or an equivalent urgent cholangitis assessment. Blood pressure not supplied must not be invented.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek the previous operation and available outside records.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The surgery type, timing and underlying disease materially alter the differential.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: A request for the operative note, surgical summary or outside records is adequate even though the original note cannot be supplied. Available pathology/summary is an acceptable partial alternative; acknowledging the gap is required rather than guessing a surgical injury.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request biliary imaging to establish obstruction and characterise its level or content.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Jaundice with pain and fever requires an anatomical assessment, especially after liver surgery.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Ultrasound or cross-sectional biliary imaging, MRCP/CT review, or an equivalent urgent specialist biliary investigation route. Exact anticipation of the eventual non-calculous material is unnecessary.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.
